Class GraphElement

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, CanvasItem
Direct Known Subclasses:
GraphPlace, GraphTransition, PortAnchor
public class GraphElement extends Object implements Serializable, CanvasItem
Base class for all drawable graph elements (places, transitions, arcs). Moved from graphpresentation to graphnet so the graph model layer has no dependency on the UI presentation layer.

    Moves this element by a delta, keeping whatever anchors its shape - every concrete element positions itself from its centre, so this reads the centre back, shifts it, and hands the result to setNewCoordinates(java.awt.geom.Point2D), which is what moveSelectionBy and the drag handlers already did by hand at every call site before this existed.

    • isCircular

      public boolean isCircular()
      Returns:
      true if an arc reaching this element should be trimmed to it by a simple radius around its centre — a place's circle, or anything that stands in for one, like a port; false to trim against a rectangle instead, the way a transition is. See GraphArc.changeBorder(), the one place this actually matters.

    • moveBy

      public void moveBy(int dx, int dy)
      Moves this element by a delta, keeping whatever anchors its shape - every concrete element positions itself from its centre, so this reads the centre back, shifts it, and hands the result to setNewCoordinates(java.awt.geom.Point2D), which is what moveSelectionBy and the drag handlers already did by hand at every call site before this existed.
      Specified by:
      moveBy in interface CanvasItem
      Parameters:
      dx - horizontal shift, in canvas coordinates
      dy - vertical shift, in canvas coordinates
